title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's PDT-101 exam
question:
What must happen in order for a newly created lead record in Salesforce to be created in Pardot immediately?
(Choose two answers.)
option_A: Salesforce connector set to automatically create prospects
option_B: Salesforce connector has sync all setting turned on
option_C: Lead record has a prospect ID at the time of creation
option_D: Lead record has an email address at the time of creation

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's PDT-101 exam
question: What is the difference between a dynamic list and a static list?
option_A: Dynamic list membership CANNOT be manually updated but static list membership can be manually updated.
option_B: Dynamic lists are retroactive while static lists CANNOT be retroactive.
option_C: Dynamic list membership can be manually updated but static list membership CANNOT be manually updated.
option_D: An action can be added to a dynamic list that will trigger when a prospect is added but an action CANNOT be added to a static list to trigger when a prospect is added.
